test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'JAIL' is coded as '304', 'LAWN' is coded as '232'. What is the code for 'NAVY' in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6e81f3ed21fddc72dd7e74439132a9341e1cd67dad9da66ee032ef789862eab.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Logic: (Sum of the opposite place value of all letters) **×** 4 = Code of the word.

'JAIL' is coded as '304'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40dfb3e10f9238c1fffdd03db558d3ce680e1f384a21689742160db64c609f09.png] 

'LAWN' is coded as '232'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38b236dd7f64abe39a4b3e3a272a0390fec540a3b8465e499c5a809c233e4f00.png] 

Similarly, for '**NAVY**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/332b9d445dd8f8e50be6fc7d9e3f97f4f995ec786c19c4c393a971d156e4cf5e.png] 

So, 'NAVY' will be coded as '184'.

Hence, the correct answer is "184".
